ينخرم (form VII)
# يَنْخَرِمُ (yanḵarimu) /jan.xa.ri.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْخَرَمَ (inḵarama)
# يَنْخَرِمَ (yanḵarima) /jan.xa.ri.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْخَرَمَ (inḵarama)
# يَنْخَرِمْ (yanḵarim) /jan.xa.rim/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْخَرَمَ (inḵarama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
